preview.text: Mongolia plays Thailand in a T20 match at Bayuemas Oval, where the usual first-innings score in the 85 recorded T20 matches is 118. Thailand won the toss and chose to bat first. The forecast for the next 8 hours predicts up to a 83 per cent chance of rain and about 31 degrees.

summary.text: Thailand won by 183 runs. THAI made 196-2, Akshaykumar Yadav top-scoring with 93 off 65 balls; Turmunkh Tumursukh took 1 for 42. MGL made 13-10, Gandemberel Ganbold top-scoring with 5 off 11 balls; Phanuphong Thongsa took 4 for 2. Sides batting first at Bayuemas Oval usually make about 118.
